rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 065 and 068: on look and feel the prototype wins by default and the real service changes to match; a subdivision's shown label is look and feel, and the only override on offer, DR1's MDM block (dr1-parity-backlog p4-029), is lifted by claims 129, 131 and 132 (no reference list waits on MDM) and survives only for who owns list content (claim 134), which the label does not change; claim 136 itself ties the destination label to 'as the origin page does'.
outcome: The country of origin list labels its subdivisions '<territory> (<parent>)' (for example 'Canary Islands (Spain)') and is sorted alphabetically by the shown label, on the origin page of both the live-animals and germinal products sets, matching Design Release 2.1's origin search and the 9 October ruling's destination select and transit country search. The label is look and feel, where the prototype wins; DR1's MDM block on these labels is lifted by the 9 October ruling and stands only for list content. Which places appear and their names stay what MDM serves, and the stored value stays the code.
